Content: HATEOAS (Hypermedia as the Engine of Application State) trong REST là gì?
Explanation: Response chứa links/actions available cho client dựa trên current state. Client navigate API qua links thay vì hardcode endpoints. Level 3 trong Richardson Maturity Model.
Option 1: Client gửi toàn bộ state trong mỗi request — giống JWT claims approach
Option 2: Server lưu client state giữa requests — stateful communication pattern
Option 3: Response chứa links/actions cho client navigate API qua links — Level 3 Richardson Maturity Model
Option 4: Hypertext protocol cho API documentation — giống Swagger/OpenAPI spec

Content: Rate Limiting API trả về status code nào khi vượt limit?
Explanation: 429 Too Many Requests. Response nên include: Retry-After header (khi nào retry), X-RateLimit-Limit (max requests), X-RateLimit-Remaining (còn lại), X-RateLimit-Reset (reset time).
Option 1: 503 Service Unavailable — server không available do overload
Option 2: 400 Bad Request — client error do gửi quá nhiều requests
Option 3: 429 Too Many Requests + Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers
Option 4: 401 Unauthorized — client không có quyền gửi thêm requests

Content: REST API error response nên chứa thông tin gì?
Explanation: Consistent error format: HTTP status code, error code (internal), message (human-readable), details/validation errors, timestamp, request ID (tracing). KHÔNG expose internal stack traces.
Option 1: HTTP status, error code, message, details, timestamp, request ID — không expose stack traces
Option 2: Chỉ cần HTTP status code — client tự infer error từ status
Option 3: Full stack trace cho debugging — chi tiết hơn giúp client fix nhanh
Option 4: Generic 'Error occurred' message — không leak information cho attacker

Content: API Gateway pattern: routing, rate limiting, auth. Khác BFF (Backend For Frontend) thế nào?
Explanation: API Gateway: single entry point cho TẤT CẢ clients, generic. BFF: backend RIÊNG cho TỪNG frontend type (web BFF, mobile BFF) — optimize response format/data cho từng client.
Option 1: Gateway và BFF là cùng pattern — chỉ khác naming convention
Option 2: Gateway single entry tất cả clients; BFF backend riêng từng frontend type — optimize per client
Option 3: Gateway cho external APIs; BFF cho internal APIs — phân chia theo access scope
Option 4: Gateway thay thế BFF — BFF deprecated khi dùng Gateway

Content: Webhook khác REST API ở communication direction nào?
Explanation: REST API: client PULL data (request → response). Webhook: server PUSH data khi event xảy ra (callback URL). Webhook: event-driven, real-time notification, less polling overhead.
Option 1: REST client pull (request-response); Webhook server push khi event xảy ra (callback URL) — event-driven
Option 2: REST push; Webhook pull — direction ngược với tên gọi
Option 3: REST và Webhook đều push data — chỉ khác transport protocol
Option 4: REST synchronous; Webhook cũng synchronous — chỉ khác trigger mechanism

Content: OpenAPI/Swagger specification dùng để làm gì?
Explanation: Define API contract: endpoints, request/response schemas, auth methods, status codes. Auto-generate: documentation (Swagger UI), client SDKs, server stubs, mock servers, test cases.
Option 1: Define API contract (endpoints/schemas/auth) — auto-generate docs, SDKs, stubs, mocks, tests
Option 2: Chỉ generate documentation — không hỗ trợ code generation hay testing
Option 3: Runtime API validation — validate requests at runtime thay vì design time
Option 4: API monitoring — track performance metrics và uptime

Content: Content Negotiation trong REST API hoạt động qua header nào?
Explanation: Client gửi Accept header (desired response format: application/json, application/xml). Server gửi Content-Type header (actual format). Server chọn format phù hợp hoặc 406 Not Acceptable.
Option 1: User-Agent header — negotiate response format based on client browser type
Option 2: Accept header (client desired format) + Content-Type header (server actual format) — 406 nếu không hỗ trợ
Option 3: Cache-Control header — negotiate caching strategy giữa client và server
Option 4: Authorization header — negotiate authentication method giữa client và server

Content: ETag header trong REST API hỗ trợ caching mechanism nào?
Explanation: ETag: fingerprint của response (hash). Client gửi If-None-Match: etag → server so sánh → 304 Not Modified (dùng cache) hoặc 200 (data mới). Conditional request giảm bandwidth.
Option 1: ETag compress response — reduce payload size cho large responses
Option 2: ETag fingerprint → If-None-Match → 304 Not Modified (cache) hoặc 200 (new data) — giảm bandwidth
Option 3: ETag version control — track API version changes
Option 4: ETag encrypt response body — security mechanism cho sensitive data

Content: Long Polling vs Server-Sent Events (SSE) cho real-time updates?
Explanation: Long Polling: client request → server giữ connection cho đến có data → respond → client request lại. SSE: server PUSH events qua persistent HTTP connection (one-directional). SSE hiệu quả hơn Long Polling.
Option 1: Long Polling push; SSE pull — direction ngược với tên gọi
Option 2: Long Polling và SSE hoạt động giống nhau — chỉ khác library/framework support
Option 3: Long Polling bidirectional; SSE unidirectional — Long Polling tốt hơn cho chat apps
Option 4: Long Polling client request giữ cho đến data respond rồi request lại; SSE server push qua persistent connection

Content: API Documentation best practices: ngoài endpoints và schemas cần gì?
Explanation: Authentication guide, code examples (multiple languages), error codes reference, rate limiting info, changelog/versioning, SDKs, quickstart tutorial, sandbox/playground environment.
Option 1: PDF document 500 trang — chi tiết hơn là tốt hơn
Option 2: Chỉ cần Swagger UI auto-generated — không cần viết thêm documentation
Option 3: Chỉ cần list endpoints — developer tự infer cách sử dụng từ endpoint naming
Option 4: Auth guide, code examples, error reference, rate limits, changelog, SDKs, quickstart, sandbox
